title: Proxmox overview
description: The PVE nodes, guests and storages at a glance, from the PVE metric server data in InfluxDB.

list.name: bucket
list.label: Cluster
list.description: InfluxDB bucket: pve_cluster (the lylat cluster) or pve_greatfox (the standalone greatfox).

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Nodes that reported to InfluxDB within the last minute of the time range (Up) and nodes seen earlier in the range that stopped reporting (Down).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "avg1")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with fresh: int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: r._time) < 60000000000}))
  |> reduce(identity: {up: 0, down: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
       up: accumulator.up + (if r.fresh then 1 else 0), down: accumulator.down + (if r.fresh then 0 else 1)}))

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: Running VMs and containers, stopped guests (templates not counted) and templates.

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and true and (r._field == "status" or r._field == "template"))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({vmid: r.vmid, nodename: r.nodename, object: r.object, _field: r._field, _value: string(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "nodename", "object"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> reduce(identity: {vms: 0, cts: 0, stopped: 0, templates: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
       vms: accumulator.vms + (if r.status == "running" and r.object == "qemu" then 1 else 0),
       cts: accumulator.cts + (if r.status == "running" and r.object == "lxc" then 1 else 0),
       stopped: accumulator.stopped + (if r.status != "running" and not exists r.template then 1 else 0),
       templates: accumulator.templates + (if exists r.template then 1 else 0)}))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Busy share of all node cores (pvestatd's cpu, weighted by cores).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and true and (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(identity: {used: 0.0, cpus: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({used: accumulator.used + r.cpu * r.cpus, cpus: accumulator.cpus + r.cpus}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.used / r.cpus}))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used / total memory over all nodes (used = total - available).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and true and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(identity: {used: 0.0, total: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({used: accumulator.used + r.memused, total: accumulator.total + r.memtotal}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.used / r.total}))

panels.title: Allocated to running guests
panels.description: vCPUs and configured memory of the running guests, against the nodes' cores and RAM. Above 1x vCPUs is normal overcommit; memory near 100% leaves no room for an HA failover.

targets.query:
import "date"
guests = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and (r._field == "cpus" or r._field == "maxmem" or r._field == "uptime"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.uptime > 0.0)
  |> reduce(identity: {vcpus: 0.0, vmem: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({vcpus: accumulator.vcpus + r.cpus, vmem: accumulator.vmem + r.maxmem}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with k: 1}))
nodes = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.object == "nodes" and ((r._measurement == "cpustat" and r._field == "cpus") or (r._measurement == "memory" and r._field == "memtotal")))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> reduce(identity: {cores: 0.0, mem: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({cores: accumulator.cores + r.cpus, mem: accumulator.mem + r.memtotal}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with k: 1}))
join(tables: {g: guests, n: nodes}, on: ["k"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({vCPUs: r.vcpus / r.cores, memory: r.vmem / r.mem}))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Last values in the time range. State is DOWN when the node stopped reporting. Network is the current rate summed over the physical NICs. Click a node for its dashboard.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.object == "nodes" and true and (
       (r._measurement == "cpustat" and (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus" or r._field == "wait" or r._field == "avg5")) or
       (r._measurement == "memory" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal" or r._field == "swapused" or r._field == "swaptotal")) or
       (r._measurement == "blockstat" and r._field == "per") or
       (r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "uptime")))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({host: r.host, _field: r._field, _value: float(v: r._value), _time: r._time}))
age = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uptime")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({host: r.host, _field: "age", _value: float(v: int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0, _time: r._time}))
union(tables: [data, age])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({host: r.host, up: if r.age < 60.0 then 1 else 0, uptime: r.uptime, cpu: r.cpu,
       cores: r.cpus, load: r.avg5 / r.cpus, iowait: r.wait, mem: r.memused / r.memtotal, memtotal: r.memtotal,
       swap: if r.swaptotal > 0.0 then r.swapused / r.swaptotal else 0.0, rootfs: r.per / 100.0}))

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r._field == "status")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["nodename"])
  |> reduce(identity: {running: 0, guests: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
       running: accumulator.running + (if r._value == "running" then 1 else 0), guests: accumulator.guests + 1}))
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {nodename: "host"})

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r.instance =~ /^(eth|en|wl)/ and (r._field == "receive" or r._field == "transmit"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["host", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "cpu")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.host}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.memused / r.memtotal}))
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.host}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Load (5m) per core
panels.description: 5-minute load average divided by the node's cores; above 1 means runnable tasks are waiting.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "avg5" or r._field == "cpus"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.avg5 / r.cpus}))
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.host}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Network per node (physical NICs)
panels.description: Summed over each node's physical NICs (bond members and uplinks); one color per node, inbound up (solid), outbound down (dashed).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r.instance =~ /^(eth|en|wl)/ and (r._field == "receive" or r._field == "transmit"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
        |> group(columns: ["host", "_field"])
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.host + (if r._field == "receive" then " in" else " out")}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: IO wait per node
panels.description: Share of CPU time spent waiting for I/O.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "wait")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.host}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Top guests by CPU
panels.description: Share of each guest's own vCPUs in use.

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and (r._field == "cpu"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({guest: r.host, _value: r.cpu}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> top(n: 10)

panels.title: Top guests by memory
panels.description: Host memory used by the guest (memhost for VMs, mem for containers).

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and (r._field == "mem" or r._field == "memhost"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({guest: r.host, _value: if exists r.memhost then r.memhost else r.mem}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> top(n: 10)

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and (r._field == "diskread" or r._field == "diskwrite"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({guest: r.host, _value: r.diskread + r.diskwrite}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> top(n: 10)

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and (r._field == "netin" or r._field == "netout"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({guest: r.host, _value: (r.netin + r.netout) * 8.0}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> top(n: 10)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r._field == "status")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, object: r.object, _value: if r._value == "running" then 1 else 0}))
        |> group(columns: ["object"])
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r.object == "qemu" then "VMs" else "CTs"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Guest CPU by node (cores)
panels.description: Cores busy running guests, per node.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus"))
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, nodename: r.nodename, _value: r.cpu * r.cpus}))
        |> group(columns: ["nodename"])
        |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.nodename}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: Used / total. Shared storages once, local ones per node.

targets.query:
import "date"
nums = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and true and
       (r._field == "total" or r._field == "used" or r._field == "avail" or r._field == "shared" or r._field == "active" or r._field == "enabled"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
strs = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and true and (r._field == "type" or r._field == "content"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
join(tables: {n: nums, s: strs}, on: ["host", "nodename"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with storage: if r.shared == 1.0 then r.host else r.host + " (" + r.nodename + ")",
       pct: if r.total > 0.0 then r.used / r.total else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["storage"])
  |> first(column: "storage")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["pct"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["storage", "pct"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and true and
       (r._field == "used" or r._field == "total" or r._field == "shared"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.used / r.total,
       series: if r.shared == 1.0 then r.host else r.host + " (" + r.nodename + ")"}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> unique(column: "_time")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
